capture.summary: A recorded trace a member offers: /simulations/presets lists each preset's captures. Its requests and its routing are the capture's.

generated.summary: A trace req-frontend's tracegen draws from `generator`: `type` and the generator's arguments, each a string as its flag takes it.

generators.about: Draw a session workload from distributions, with no corpus at all

arguments.help: Fresh input tokens per round — the part not carried from the previous round. `512`, `uniform:256..2048`, `lognormal:1024,0.8`
arguments.name: input_len

arguments.help: Milliseconds a session waits between one round completing and the next being submitted
arguments.name: tool_wait_ms

arguments.help: Chance that a round drops its carried context instead of reusing it, standing in for a compaction. Round 0 never carries anything, so this applies from round 1 onward
arguments.name: compaction_probability

arguments.help: Synthetic session arrival rate, in sessions per second
arguments.name: arrival_rate

arguments.help: Seed for every draw here. Same seed, same trace, byte for byte
arguments.name: seed

generators.name: synthetic

upload.summary: A CSV you send to POST /workloads (body: the file). Its format and tags are the ones its header fits, or the query's `format` and `tags` (comma-separated); the answer's workload_id is the simulation's workload.upload.

routing: An MoE member routes every workload's tokens as one of its captures does: workload.capture names it, its first by default.

Load.description:
How hard a simulation drives its requests: ``rate``, the requests (a
session trace's sessions) per second they arrive at, the trace's own spacing
scaled to that mean; or ``concurrency``, every request ready at once and at
most this many in flight. A workload with no load replays the trace's own
arrival times.
Load.title: Load

workload.description:
What a simulation replays. ``source`` says where its requests come from:
a capture the member offers, a trace ``generator`` draws, or an ``upload``
(``GET /workloads`` describes both). Every request of the source runs.
workload.title: Workload
